sources.snippet: This repository contains Qwen3-ASR-1.7B model, which support language identification and speech recognition for 30 languages and 22 Chinese dialects, optimized for Renesas X5H platform for automatic speech recognition inference.

sources.snippet: The Qwen3-ASR family includes Qwen3-ASR-1.7B and Qwen3-ASR-.6B, which support language identification and ASR for 52 languages and dialects.
